description: Recompute per-residue pLDDT for AF-Q96KN4-F1-v6 and write the evidence matrix and GO decision table used in the final report
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---- per-residue pLDDT of AF-Q96KN4-F1 (v6), recomputed live from AlphaFold DB
api=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q96KN4",timeout=60).json()
pdb=requests.get(api[0]["pdbUrl"],timeout=60).text
rows={}
for ln in pdb.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        rows[int(ln[22:26])]=float(ln[60:66])
pl=pd.Series(rows).sort_index()
pd.DataFrame({"residue":pl.index,"pLDDT":pl.values}).to_csv("lratd1_plddt.csv",index=False)
print("model:",api[0]["pdbUrl"].split("/")[-1],"residues:",len(pl))
print("mean pLDDT 1-132: %.1f   133-228: %.1f   229-292: %.1f"%(
      pl.loc[1:132].mean(), pl.loc[133:228].mean(), pl.loc[229:292].mean()))
print("pLDDT at Ser38 = %.1f ; His143 = %.1f ; His155 = %.1f ; Ser212 = %.1f"%(
      pl[38],pl[143],pl[155],pl[212]))

# ---- evidence matrix
ev = pd.DataFrame([
["PMID:10819989","direct assay (site-directed mutagenesis, enzyme kinetics)","supports",
 "The Cys at the LRAT nucleophile position is required for acyl transfer and serine cannot replace it",
 "C161A and C168A activities are virtually nil; C161S possesses only a few percent of wild-type LRAT activity; LRAT is a thiol acyltransferase",
 "human RPE LRAT, recombinant, in vitro","High for the chemistry. Tests LRAT, not LRATD1."],
["PMID:21880860","direct assay (enzyme activity on purified and overexpressed protein)","supports",
 "Cys-containing LRAT-domain proteins are active enzymes",
 "PLAAT1 (A-C1) has Ca2+-independent PLA1/PLA2 and acyltransferase activity; all five HRASLS members show similar catalytic properties",
 "human, mouse, rat recombinant protein; COS-7 homogenates","High. Establishes the active comparator set."],
["PMID:25383759","structural (2.2 A crystal structure)","supports",
 "Catalysis in this family runs through a covalent thioester on the nucleophilic cysteine",
 "HRASLS3-LRAT chimeric enzyme crystallised in a thioester catalytic intermediate state",
 "human HRASLS3/LRAT chimera","High. A thioester intermediate requires a thiol; a serine hydroxyl cannot form one."],
["PMID:32183428","review with review-level report of the authors' mutagenesis","supports and qualifies",
 "The LRATD1 paralog FAM84B also lacks the catalytic cysteine",
 "FAM84B conserves H23 and H35 but not C113; deletion of the conserved motif abolishes FAM84B oncogenic activities",
 "human FAM84B, cancer cell lines","Moderate. Review-level; no separate primary PMID for the motif deletion was found in Europe PMC."],
["PDB 4DOT + AF-Q96KN4-F1-v6 (this work)","structural / computational","supports",
 "The LRATD1 LRAT domain keeps the active-site architecture with a serine at the nucleophile position",
 "89 CA pairs superposed at RMSD 1.34 A; Ser212 CB 1.76 A from PLAAT3 Cys113 CB; His143 ND1 to Ser212 OG 3.12 A; His-His dyad 2.86 A; nearest cysteine SG 11.26 A from Ser212 OG",
 "human, in silico","High for geometry. AlphaFold model; no experimental LRATD1 structure exists."],
["UniProt orthologs (this work)","structural / evolutionary","supports",
 "The cysteine loss is an ancient fixed state, not a human or annotation artefact",
 "His143, His155, Cys208 and Ser212 invariant in 16 of 16 vertebrate orthologs spanning 63.0-99.3 percent identity",
 "vertebrates, human to Takifugu rubripes","High. Orthologs selected by gene name plus organism in UniProt, not a formal orthology reconstruction."],
["PMID:15078103; PMID:8819168; PMID:22659439","direct assay and computational chemistry","qualifies (closes the serine-hydrolase alternative)",
 "A serine cannot act as an efficient nucleophile in a papain-like cysteine-protease active site",
 "SARS 3CLpro C145S retains 40-fold lower activity; triad geometries are inverted between serine and cysteine proteinases; Cys to Ser is used as an inactivating mutation in cathepsin L-like proteinases",
 "viral and insect enzymes, ab initio calculations","Moderate to high. None of these is an LRAT-family enzyme."],
["PMID:16820875","overexpression phenotype and localization","qualifies (only LRATD1 primary paper)",
 "What FAM84A does in cells",
 "FAM84A is not expressed in 23 normal tissues except testis; protein localises to the subcellular membrane region limited to the region lacking attachment with neighboring cells; exogenous expression increased cell motility in NIH3T3; phosphorylation of serine 38 was associated with cell morphology",
 "human colon cancer tissue and NIH3T3 overexpression","Low to moderate for function. Overexpression in a heterologous line; no catalytic assay and no domain mutants."],
["QuickGO and InterPro2GO (this work)","database","qualifies",
 "Whether an acyltransferase annotation exists that would need removal",
 "Q96KN4 has no catalytic MF; IPR007053, IPR043299 and IPR051496 map to no GO term",
 "database records","High. Reflects the state at the time of retrieval."],
["PMID:32296183; PMID:32814053","interaction (yeast two-hybrid)","competing / qualifies",
 "Whether LRATD1 has characterised binding partners that suggest a non-catalytic role",
 "HuRI reports binding to MAST1 (Q12774) and CYGB (Q8WWM9); the neurodegeneration interactome reports ATXN10 (Q9UBB4)",
 "human ORFeome yeast two-hybrid","Low. High-throughput screens with no orthogonal validation and no mapping to the LRAT domain."],
["AlphaMissense (this work)","computational","qualifies",
 "Whether the vestigial pocket is still under selective constraint",
 "Glu213 0.996, Phe215 0.995, Trp144 0.983, His155 0.951, Ser212 0.918 against a LRAT-domain mean of 0.676",
 "in silico","Low to moderate. AlphaMissense is MSA-informed, so it is not independent of the conservation analysis."],
], columns=["citation","evidence_type","stance","claim_tested","key_finding","context","confidence_and_limitations"])
ev.to_csv("evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)

# ---- GO decision table
godec = pd.DataFrame([
["GO:0047173","phosphatidylcholine-retinol O-acyltransferase activity","MF","not annotated","do not add; candidate NOT annotation",
 "Nucleophile Cys161-equivalent is Ser212 in all 16 vertebrate orthologs; C161S leaves a few percent activity (PMID:10819989)"],
["GO:0016746","acyltransferase activity","MF","not annotated","do not add; candidate NOT annotation",
 "Same loss of the thioester-forming cysteine; thioester intermediate shown for the family (PMID:25383759)"],
["GO:0004623 / GO:0008970","phospholipase A2 / phospholipase A1 activity","MF","not annotated","do not add",
 "Family PLA1/PLA2 activity depends on the same Cys (PMID:21880860); LRATD1 lacks it"],
["GO:0017171","serine hydrolase activity","MF","not annotated","do not add",
 "Ser212-His143-His155 sits in a papain-like geometry where serine is a poor nucleophile (PMID:8819168, PMID:15078103)"],
["GO:0005515","protein binding","MF","annotated, IPI, 2 high-throughput Y2H papers","retain but flag as uninformative",
 "Only MF on the record; partners MAST1, CYGB, ATXN10 are unvalidated Y2H hits"],
["GO:0000902","cell morphogenesis","BP","annotated IBA and IMP PMID:16820875","retain, mark as non-core",
 "Derived from overexpression of FAM84A in NIH3T3 and from Ser38 phosphorylation, a downstream phenotype"],
["GO:0048870","cell motility","BP","annotated IBA and IMP PMID:16820875","retain, mark as non-core",
 "Same overexpression experiment; no evidence it is a direct activity of the LRAT domain"],
["GO:0005737","cytoplasm","CC","annotated IEA and EXP PMID:16820875","verify; possible mis-summary",
 "PMID:16820875 reports staining in the subcellular membrane region limited to regions lacking cell-cell attachment, which reads as a membrane-proximal pool"],
["(none)","no catalytic MF is supportable","MF","n/a","record the pseudoenzyme conclusion as a review comment",
 "The analysis is preventive: it blocks future acyltransferase transfer from LRAT/PLAAT paralogs rather than removing an existing term"],
], columns=["go_id","term","aspect","current_status_on_Q96KN4","recommended_action_lead","basis"])
godec.to_csv("go_decision_table.csv",index=False)

print("\n=== evidence_matrix.csv rows:",len(ev))
print(ev[["citation","evidence_type","stance"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\n=== go_decision_table.csv")
print(godec[["go_id","term","current_status_on_Q96KN4","recommended_action_lead"]].to_string(index=False))

# ---- figure: domain architecture by pLDDT, with the sites marked
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(14,4.6))
ax.plot(pl.index,pl.values,color="#2166ac",lw=1.4)
ax.axhspan(90,100,color="#4daf4a",alpha=0.10); ax.axhspan(70,90,color="#ffd92f",alpha=0.10)
ax.axhspan(50,70,color="#fdae61",alpha=0.12); ax.axhspan(0,50,color="#d73027",alpha=0.10)
ax.axvspan(133,228,color="#2166ac",alpha=0.08)
ax.text(180,20,"LRAT domain 133-228\nmean pLDDT %.1f"%pl.loc[133:228].mean(),ha="center",fontsize=11)
ax.text(66,20,"N-terminal region 1-132\nmean pLDDT %.1f"%pl.loc[1:132].mean(),ha="center",fontsize=11)
for p,lab,c in [(38,"Ser38\n(phosphosite, PMID 16820875)","#d73027"),
                (143,"His143","#111111"),(155,"His155","#111111"),
                (212,"Ser212\n(nucleophile position)","#d73027")]:
    ax.plot([p],[pl[p]],"o",color=c,ms=7,zorder=5)
    ax.annotate(lab,(p,pl[p]),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(0,14),
                ha="center",fontsize=9,color=c)
ax.set_xlabel("residue of human LRATD1 (Q96KN4)",fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT",fontsize=11)
ax.set_xlim(1,292); ax.set_ylim(0,112)
ax.set_title("LRATD1 is a confidently modelled LRAT domain on a low-confidence N-terminal region\n"
             "model AF-Q96KN4-F1-v6, per-residue pLDDT read from the deposited coordinates",fontsize=12,loc="left")
plt.show()
